title: Schwarz symmetry of mixed directional second derivatives of a C² function (parent Step 1)
statement: Let k ∈ ℕ and let f : ℝ^k → ℝ (ℝ^k = Eucl k = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)) be of class C² (ContDiff ℝ 2 f). For u ∈ ℝ^k write ∂_u f(y) := Df(y)u = fderiv ℝ f y u. Then for all x, u, v ∈ ℝ^k the derivative at x in direction v of y ↦ ∂_u f(y) equals the derivative at x in direction u of y ↦ ∂_v f(y): fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ f y u) x v = fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ f y v) x u.
lean_statement: ∀ (k : ℕ) (f : Eucl k → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 2 f → ∀ x u v : Eucl k, fderiv ℝ (fun y : Eucl k => fderiv ℝ f y u) x v = fderiv ℝ (fun y : Eucl k => fderiv ℝ f y v) x u
